title: Moulton doubles down on Epstein-related attacks on Markey
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Rep. Seth Moulton accused Sen. Ed Markey of connections to Jeffrey Epstein in new debate, prompting strong denials from Markey.
Moulton posted images alleging Markey's involvement with the 'Epstein lobbying effort,' which Markey called a distraction from Moulton's defense investments.
The files referenced in allegations show contacts with lobbyists, not a direct link between Markey and Epstein, according to records.

title: New Red Sox reliever Erik Miller says he learned about trade from TV
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Red Sox acquired reliever Erik Miller from the Giants in exchange for Marcelo Mayer.
Miller learned about his trade to Boston from a TV segment just before playing catch.
The 28-year-old lefty debuted at Fenway, notching a strikeout on four pitches against the White Sox.

title: ‘Sheer grit and determination’: Mass. 18-year-old with leg injury meets rescuers halfway on Mount Washington
author: John Waller
bullets: Andrew Nelson, 18, injured his leg near Mount Washington's summit and hiked 0.3 miles toward rescuers despite his injury.
The New Hampshire Fish and Game Department responded to a 911 call about Nelson on the Tuckerman Ravine Trail.
Rescue crews met Nelson, provided medical assistance, and transported him partway down, but he opted for treatment at home.

title: Body washes up at Orient Heights Beach in East Boston
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A female body was discovered at Orient Heights Beach in East Boston around 1 p.m. Tuesday.
The Suffolk County District Attorney's Office reported the body was found near Bayswater Street.
The investigation into the circumstances surrounding the discovery is ongoing, officials stated.

title: Charts: See how much Markey and Moulton have raised so far
author: Annie Jonas
bullets: Seth Moulton raised $5.6 million for the Massachusetts Democratic Senate primaries as of June end, surpassing Ed Markey's $4.8 million.
By June 30, Moulton had $2.6 million in cash reserves, while Markey had $2.2 million available.
The Democratic primary winner on September 1 will compete in the general election on November 3.

title: Weston police investigating after masked person spotted outside home overnight
author: John Waller
bullets: Weston police are investigating a masked person spotted on Highland Street property early Sunday morning.
The suspect, wearing a bicycle helmet, was captured on surveillance between 2:30 and 3:30 a.m.
Authorities request local residents review their surveillance footage for evidence of suspicious activity.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial resumes with a half-day of testimony
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Judge William Sullivan dismissed jurors early in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial, set to resume Thursday morning.
Forensic toxicologist Justin Brower testified on Lindsay Clancy's blood toxicology results, indicating quetiapine was slightly elevated.
Physician assistant Eitan Negri detailed cuts on Lindsay Clancy's wrists, noting some required stitches post-suicide attempt.

title: This budget airline at Logan Airport is adding first class seats in 2027
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Allegiant will introduce Allegiant First class seating on select aircraft in 2027 at Logan Airport, enhancing passenger comfort.
Allegiant First features include recline, calf rests, adjustable headrests, and 37-inch pitch, with complimentary luggage and priority boarding.
Allegiant offers complimentary beverages since August 1, and recently merged with Sun Country, maintaining separate operations temporarily.

title: Caleb Durbin’s resurgence has been a symbol of Red Sox’ improbable run
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Caleb Durbin hit his first career grand slam, a key moment in Red Sox's 14-2 win over the White Sox.
Durbin's performance helped the Red Sox extend their win streak to six games, going 24-3 in the last 27 games.
Durbin improved his stats significantly, now batting .308 with 10 home runs and 33 RBI over his last 57 games.

title: Recent homes sales in Greater Boston (Aug. 5)
author: The Boston Globe
bullets: Abington's highest recent home sale was a one-family Colonial at 22 Nardone Circle for $1,185,000.
Arlington's most expensive sale was a Colonial at 85 Oakland Ave, sold for $2,755,000.
Andover witnessed a high sale of $2,400,000 for a Colonial at 2 Barron Court.
